RESPIRATION. [26] [Con.]
Want of breath on taking least exercise and copious cough, with mucous discharge.
Shortness of breath when walking.
Constriction of chest, with dyspnœa. θ Cough.
Oppressed breathing in morning when waking.
Sawing, snoring breathing. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Asthmatic paroxysms come on in wet weather ; face bluish-red.
Asthma in morning when awaking.
Nervous bronchial asthma.
Asthma of old people, with tickling cough.
Noise in larynx, which resembles very much an unarticulated "sha-li-sha-li" in sound ; this so disturbing that he must cease going to school ; marked spasmodic twitchings of muscles of right side of face ; these often precede the sounds ; spasmodic pressing pain in region of ligam. glottid. ; noise and twitchings of face < from talking, > by rest and sleep ; patient scrofulous and glands are swollen. θ Affection of inf. laryngeal nerve.
Bronchitis.
Catarrh, with dry, tickling cough, great lassitude, restlessness and thirst.
   

COUGH. [27] [Con.]
Unbearable titillation in pit of throat, with lisping voice, causing paroxysms of coughing.
Periodic, dry cough with tickling sensation in throat, or behind sternum ; cough comes on in short spells, especially while lying down, talking or laughing.
Dry, tickling cough after catarrh, spasmodic tickling in larynx, which is very sensitive to touch ; cough recurs every evening at 6 o'clock, lasting several hours, and is very annoying to patient.
Tickling, dry cough, annoying most at night, with violent headache, disturbing sleep ; fluent coryza ; oppression of chest.
Powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough excited by itching and tickling in chest and throat, or by a dry spot in larynx, < at night and when lying down, greatly fatiguing patient.
Dry cough, < towards morning, with constriction and oppression of chest.
Dry, tearing cough, persistent and annoying, < lying down, going out of warm room into air, and changing position in bed at night. θ Anemia of brain.
Dry, hacking, almost continuous cough ; < on lying down at night ; hardly any cough during day ; paroxysms of cough simulating whooping cough.
Especially dry, tickling cough in children and nightly cough of adults.
Cough, when first lying down, during day or evening ; is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Cough very much < by lying down ; in beginning many shocks of coughing as if he would vomit ; constant severe cough in evening on going to sleep.
Cough, wakes frequently at night out of a restless sleep, with stitching pains in sides of chest.
Dry, spasmodic, nightly, almost continually titillating cough, with violent oppression of chest and evening fever ; suffocating cough in scrofulous patients ; want of breath on taking least exercise and copious cough, with mucous discharge.
Chronic cough from enlargement of bronchial glands, or irritation of laryngeal lining ; dry, hacking, laryngeal cough.
Headache during violent coughing fits.
Lying down and taking a deep breath cause cough.
Sensation when coughing as if he must take hold of abdomen, feels as if cough proceeded from there. θ Anemia of brain.
Child complains of pain in belly when coughing.
Cough, with flatulency, dyspnœa, pain in limbs and on different places of chest, not < by the cough.
Cough with : stitches in head or chest ; shocks in head ; oppression and constriction of chest ; colic ; vomiting of mucus ; pain in abdomen.
Spasmodic cough after influenza, not ceasing until a mass of mucus is vomited.
After influenza : cough coming with no regularity, but more frequent at night than at any other time and continuing until retching and vomiting occur, expelling a small quantity of frothy mucus with a yellow nucleus.
Cough : loose, with inability to expectorate ; must swallow what is raised.
Whooping cough : expectoration only during day, with attacks of suffocation ; tickling in chest, shortness of breath, bloody mucus : difficulty in expectorating what has been loosened by cough, < at night.
Violent attacks of whooping cough in scrofulous children, face flushed, expectoration bloody.
Whooping cough if subacute bronchitis has supervened.
Expectoration : during day ; difficult ; bloody, purulent, sometimes hardened ; of putrid taste and smell, especially after measles, scarlatina, or during pregnancy.
Violent cough at night, with influenza.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Tickling sensation behind sternum.
Tight feeling in chest, > by cough.
Oppressive constriction of chest, with dry cough.
Violent oppression of chest and evening fever.
Pressure on chest, with spasmodic, tickling night cough.
Pains all over chest, with headache.
Itching, scraping, titillation under sternum, or in throat, causing periodic dry cough.
Sharp thrusts directly through chest, from sternum to spine, while sitting.
Stitches : in right chest about nipple, on every inspiration, while walking, < from hard pressure with hand ; in left side of chest, with uterine spasms ; from abdomen to right side of chest.
Jerks in chest.
Cutting pains in both sides of chest, < by inspiration ; tension and weakness in chest ; visible palpitation, especially after drinking.
Dull pain in left chest, tenth rib, < from coughing. θ Anemia of brain.
Hæmoptysis, or hemorrhage especially after masturbation, with tensive, pressing, stitching pains in chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Con.]
Precordial anguish.
Jerking sensation about heart.
Violent palpitation of heart. θ Morning sickness.
Violent palpitation after drinking, when rising from bed.
Palpitation after stool ; intermissions in beats of heart.
Violent beating of heart, with pain at each pulsation, as if a knife was being thrust through occiput ; heart beat sometimes strong, sometimes quick or vacillating.
Frequent shocks in region of heart.
Aching or sharp pains about heart, with dysmenorrhœa.
Sensible beating of arteries through whole body.
Pulse : accelerated ; unequal in strength and sometimes irregular in rhythm ; irregular, generally slow and full, alternating with small and frequent beats ; extremely irregular, principally slow and large, but with intervening small and quick beats ; pulseless.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Itching of breast and nipple, with red, scaly skin, and burning after rubbing.
Stitches as with needles in left mamma.
Stitching pain in sides of chest, with cough, which wakes him at night.
Violent stitches in left side of chest above nipple, on every inspiration while walking, not > by hard pressure of hand.
Violent stitches in right side, as if a knife was plunged into side, causing loud moaning. θ Pneumonia.
Beating stitch, with pain, in upper and left part of chest towards centre of chest.
Inflammation of breast, with stitches.
The mammary glands painful in evening.
Pain in mamma, which often swell and become hard.
Hot pains through left breast and axilla. θ Uterine disorder.
Dull pain below left mamma. θ Prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Hardness of right mamma, with painfulness to touch, and nightly stitches in it.
Mammary induration following abscess of right mammary gland, remaining without change for two years.
Painful swelling of breast, about size of walnut.
Hard and painful lumps in mamma.
Tumor under left nipple as large as a hen's egg, moving freely under superficial fascia, and very hard and painful on pressure ; nipple inverted and sensitive to touch ; stinging, twinging pains ; leaden cast of areola.
Small and painless tumor in breast near nipple.
Tumors in mamma, with piercing pains, < at night, gland abnormally tender.
From contusion, hard lump as large as walnut on right side of nipple of right breast ; constant, dull, heavy pain in breast ; at night after spot has been irritated in any way, sharp and shooting pains.
After contusion of right breast, an uneven swelling, hard as stone, supporting a rough, wart-like, humid elevation ; axillary glands swollen ; fever in evening ; dull stitches in breast.
Hard, scirrhous-like tumors.
Stony-hard scirrhus of breast, sharp, shooting pains and occasional twinges.
Scirrhus in mamma, hard as cartilage and uneven, which had grown during climacteric period to size of hen's egg.
Scirrhous cancer of breast, stony, hard, large as teacup ; pains shooting ; sense of great heaviness in breast.
Scirrhus of left breast ; occasionally twitching in affected part, rarely pain ; the mass is immovable, and skin covering it not discolored.
Hypertrophy of breast, either general or lobular, followed by atrophy.
Wasting of breasts ; complete atrophy of mammary gland, leaving a flaccid, baglike skin.
Caries of sternum.
